function.arguments: {"finding": "The analysis assumes that adjusting for customer_segment is sufficient to eliminate confounding. However, the data shows that the email channel was targeted at loyal customers, who may also have higher lifetime value, purchase frequency, or other unobserved traits. The adjustment only accounts for segment, but other confounders (e.g., order value, time since first purchase) are not measured. Thus, even after stratification, residual confounding may remain. Additionally, the model uses a weighted average, but this assumes that the segment distribution in the filtered dataset is representative and that the segments are homogeneous, which may not hold.", "implication": "The conclusion that the campaign was not successful is not causal. It is a descriptive comparison adjusted for one confounder. We cannot claim causality. The answer must reflect this limitation."}
function.name: note_finding
